decision: Use a no-weights exact-shape microbenchmark as the cheapest falsifier of the measured grouped-MLA launch-resource lead before another full-server allocation.
causal_hypothesis: At least one hardware-legal grouped MLA decode configuration reduces both stage-1 and full-attention batch-8 p50 time by at least 10% versus the source-pinned vLLM stock configuration across every sampled steady-decode length, without numerical failure. Expected direction: lower shared-memory/register pressure or a better split/tile balance may improve occupancy and latency; the earlier BLOCK_N=64/stage=1 server regression makes a null or negative result plausible.

diagnostic_trace_only.claim_limit: not an end-to-end, batch-8, phase-scoped, or Amdahl coefficient

workload_geometry.model: GLM-4.7-Flash AWQ architecture geometry without weights
workload_geometry.key_cache: [physical_pages,16,1,576] BF16 with shuffled physical page mapping
workload_geometry.candidate_space: 58 unique configurations over block_h={8,16,32}, legal block_n/stage pairs, warps={2,4,8}, and stock-tile splits={1,2,4,8,16}

correctness_and_quality_gate: The stock kernel must compile, be hardware legal, produce finite output/LSE, and match an independent FP32 attention oracle within the pinned tolerances on all ten shapes. Every candidate must pass the same gate on all shapes; no model-quality claim is permitted because weights are absent.
component_performance_gate: A candidate becomes a lead for a true c8 trace only if its conservative minimum across five B=8 lengths is at least 10% faster for both stage-1 and the complete grouped-attention component. Component success does not promote to an end-to-end server holdout until a scope-matched c8 critical-path share or empirical A/B supports at least 5% prospective end-to-end effect.
slo: Not applicable to a component harness. Record every latency sample summary, compile/resource failure, sweep wall time, GPU utilization, VRAM, power, clocks, temperature, and total allocation exposure. The next server arm retains the existing TTFT p95 <= 10000 ms and TPOT p95 <= 100 ms SLO.
telemetry: wall time and total allocation cost
artifact_contract: Retrieve a deterministic tarball and remote SHA-256 before teardown containing the immutable preregistration identity, source/runtime identities, command, phases, native imports, pip freeze, initial/final nvidia-smi, one-second telemetry, all candidate/shape rows, summaries, stdout/stderr, and internal manifest. Verify remote/local hash and internal manifest, then delete the instance and disk, verify instance GET returns not-found, and verify fresh zero-resource inventories.
stop_rules: A stock correctness, source-identity, artifact, cleanup, or telemetry failure invalidates the allocation and permits only a materially changed in-place repair if it can start within ten minutes.
No candidate clearing the component gate stops this MLA tile/split lineage.
A component lead queues one true fixed-8K/128 c8 phase-aware trace on the tuned V21 server control; it does not by itself authorize a cost claim.
Any safety, absolute timeout, campaign budget, or provider cleanup condition ends the allocation.
next_conditional_arm: If and only if a component lead exists, preregister a strict-L40S tuned-stock server trace and same-session alternating control/candidate A/B; otherwise re-rank the cross-stack opportunity register and spend no full-model setup on MLA.
